platform: Android APK WebView/CDP; real learning/timer bridge
checks: test target is an owned emulator
no existing timer is interrupted by updater UI tests
installed version matches the manifest used for this test report
about version comes from actual installed package metadata
real native GitHub check produces a terminal status
real native check status is reflected in the update panel
updater-only proxy is captured by actual app boot while other Native methods remain real
explicit check displays pending status without claiming a completed check
canceling a pending check returns to an actionable idle state
current-version status is shown only for the current phase
error snapshots are rendered in the panel rather than discarded by generic Native error decoding
error retry actually calls the native check action
candidate version and notes are displayed as escaped text
download action shows zero initial progress without claiming a completed download
download progress reflects reported byte count
canceling download restores availability without a completion or installation claim
download failure offers the appropriate download retry
missing installation permission is a visible status with a user-initiated action
verified ready state reports downloaded without claiming installation success
requesting installation does not change the installed version or announce success
asynchronous update progress preserves unsaved settings input and dirty state
unsaved form blocks installation with a visible local recovery instruction
blocked installation retains the current form input
checking/downloading fixtures do not save settings or modify learning records
long update notes and actions fit a 320px viewport at 200% CSS text size
update controls retain accessible names in the real WebView accessibility tree
active native timer exposes cancel/save/discard choices at installation time
canceling the installation timer gate preserves the actual paused timer
canceling discard confirmation retains the timer and does not request installation
save-and-continue persists the actual timer session before requesting installation
confirmed discard clears only the pending timer before requesting installation
no uncaught WebView exception in update status and installation-gate flows
fixtureScope: Only getUpdateState/checkUpdate/downloadUpdate/cancelUpdate/installUpdate are overridden after the live check. Fixture download and install actions never download or install an APK.
unverified: Fixture states do not verify APK transfer, checksum/signature verification, permission-settings return, or actual Package Installer behavior; these require native/platform tests.
